lines.text: …Sit down, Kagami. Ask what you came to ask. I closed that file. You read the signature.
Did you go to Seiran Academy yourself?
Course I went. Roof, annex, the whole walk-through. Wet tiles, no rail, everyone said she slipped. Three days, kid. Filed it.
Who is your source? Did the killer send you anything?
Source? You're my source, kid — you're sitting in front of me. And yeah, the killer sent something. Red crane on my desk. 'You closed the file, Inspector.' That's it. No name, no note.

...So you read it. All of it, huh. Then you noticed the dates. Three days, Kagami. I didn't close it because I believed it. Third day, the chief called me in. Ueno — the board liaison, dead man number three — wanted it finished before entrance exams. School's reputation. I had doubts. Ishida was too calm. Kurosaki too quick with her story. And I signed anyway. Got promoted that autumn. Never said that out loud before. *stares at the table* Got a cigarette on you?

...Elder sister. Yeah. She came. Every day for a month, sat in that lobby polite as anything. Short hair, glasses, maybe nineteen. I called her Mori-san, never even learned her first name. Told her to go home and grieve. Last visit, she left a white paper crane on my desk. Kept it a year. Then I threw it away. *rubs his face* God, I don't even know her name.
